Health is a priority sector under District Mineral Foundation Trust @MFT) and the DMFT Administation strives
to improve health indicaton of people directly or indirectly affected by mining or ancillary operations. Further, to fill the
vacancies of Specialist Medical Officer in hospitals at all levels and to reduce people's dependence on private health setup, it
is crucial to strengthen the public health sector by manning experts across govemment facilities. Thus, DMFT intends to
recruit medical professionals on contactual basis for govemment health institutions for Godda district. Applications are
invited from suitable candidates (Age between23-64 years) for rendering services for the positions as detailed and
described below: -

2. The service will be purely on contractual basis for a period of one year, renewable subject to satisfactory
performance. Any claim for absorption in the regular position in the District Mineral Foundation Trust, Godda shall
not be entertained. Performance will be reviewed after tlree months of the contact if work is not found to be
satisfactory, the contract may be terminated without any notice.
The successful candidates will be required to execute contractual agreement and one year bond with DMFT. Their
services will be guided by the present norms for medical offrcers under DMFT Godda. If the candidate wants to leave
within one year, then he/she will have to pay one month salary or serve one month advance notice.
DMFT Administration, Godda reserves the right to canceVmodify any or all positions or any terms and conditions in
this regard at any stage of recruifrnent process. The number of vacancies may be changed as per requirements.
Candidates must have Medical Council of India (MCIy Dental Council of India (DCI) registration.
The age of candidates must be between 23-Myears.
Candidates can download the application forms available on district's website https://godda.nic.in and attach the
following documents along with the filled application form: -
i. Resume,
ii. All Educational mark sheets and Certificates (10d', l2d', MBBS, PG Diploma / Specialization/ equivalent
certificates as indicated in the Qualification column of Table l),
iii. Caste Certificate (for those wishing to apply under reserved quota),
iv. Residential Certificate (for those wishing to apply under reserved quota),
v. Experience Certificate,
vi. Recent Passport size Photo (04 copy),
vii. Copy of PAN & AADHAR card and
viii. Any other relevant Certificate/ Testimonial/Letter of recognition or Appreciation etc.
